title: I Helped a Subscriber to Build an App in 24 Hours
promo_conflict: The video strongly features Base44 and its app-building workflow; no sponsorship or affiliate relationship is stated.

stated_problem.quote: There was no spec, no wireframe, no technical plan, not even a place to start.
stated_problem.speaker: Mikey No Code

idea.name: Custom no-code app builds
idea.one_liner: Scope, build and refine custom no-code apps for subscribers or small-business operators with workflow problems; payment terms are not stated.
idea.customer: Subscribers or community members with app ideas, including small-business operators.
idea.offer: Requirements scoping, app building, testing and handoff using a no-code builder.
idea.revenue_model: Not stated; the transcript shows a build for a subscriber but gives no price or evidence of payment.

key_quotes.quote: I helped a subscriber build an app in 24 hours.
We started by explaining that we were building a simple client tracker for Willow Lane Interiors, a one-person interior styling business in Manchester, and that Priya would be the only user.
And the whole app needed to help her answer one question quickly, who is waiting on her?

claims.claim: The host says he helped one subscriber build an app in 24 hours.
claims.quote: I helped a subscriber build an app in 24 hours.

claims.claim: The host says a working first version was ready a few hours after starting.
claims.quote: A few hours after we started, we had a working first version in her hands, real answers replacing the assumptions Basecamp [music] 44 had made, and a much clearer picture of what needed refining next.

claims.claim: Renaming the app URL took about 30 seconds.
claims.quote: It only took about 30 seconds, but it makes a surprisingly big difference to the handoff.

acquisition_channels.details: A subscriber posted her app idea in the school community; the host replied, and she asked to move the conversation to DM.

ideas.delivery: The host scopes the client's workflow with them, builds and refines the app in Base44, then shares a live URL for the client to use.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies if apps store client names, phone numbers, emails, addresses or notes; appropriate privacy information, lawful basis, access controls and security are needed.

stated_problem.quote: Her bigger problem was that she had to check WhatsApp, and notebook, and an old spreadsheet just to figure out who needed chasing in the first place.
stated_problem.speaker: Mikey No Code

idea.name: Willow Lane Interiors
idea.one_liner: A one-person interior styling business in Manchester that takes client projects from inquiry through consultation, quote and delivery.
idea.customer: Clients seeking interior styling; their specific type and location are not stated.
idea.offer: Interior styling projects for clients, managed through inquiries, consultations, quotes and completed jobs.
idea.revenue_model: Not stated; the business tracks quote values, but no fee schedule or paid project results are given.

key_quotes.quote: Priya had lost two jobs because she had not followed up, so the obvious reaction would be to build reminders.
Her five stages were new inquiry, consultation booked, quote sent, project live, and completed.
The inquiry sources were Instagram, word of mouth, a returning client, or a Google search.

claims.claim: The host describes Priya's business as a one-person interior styling business in Manchester.
claims.quote: We started by explaining that we were building a simple client tracker for Willow Lane Interiors, a one-person interior styling business in Manchester, and that Priya would be the only user.

claims.quote: And with that, we asked it to fill the first build with 12 example clients spread across all five stages using realistic British names, Manchester area addresses, and quote values between 600 and 9,000 pounds.
